about: Labeled reconcile cases for extraction against known memories (issue #1148). Each case seeds known memories (state: active, pin or proposed), then one chat. expect.noop / expect.update name the index of the known memory the model should answer about; expect.add lists term sets a new proposal must contain; an empty expect means nothing should be written. Offline, memory_evals checks the expected target is among the similar memories in the digest; live_reconcile runs a real model and gates duplicate proposals, wrong-target updates and pin edits.
